principles: Preserve genuine sync nesting pass-through; only refine the is-this-MY-lock predicate
Prevention not another cure (done_recover stays as net)
Deterministic test (race bug needs orchestrated-await proof, not timing luck)
drivers: High-severity intermittent data-integrity bug (DONE but unmerged)
Reflog-proven root cause = bare process-global Set blind to async interleaving
Parallel multi-story dev is the target workflow

options.name: (a2) process-global Set + ALS owner-token predicate (chosen)
pros: Sync nesting inherits ALS context → same token → pass-through
Concurrent sibling in separate ALS context → contends correctly
cons: Must establish ALS context at the DONE merge acquire site

options.name: (a1) held-set inside ALS run-context
cons: Harder to reconcile with the acquire/release-pair form held across actor.send

options.name: (b) serialize parallel-wave
cons: Masks defect, does not fix it

rationale: Picked after investigation. a2 keeps the proven on-disk mutex + cross-process contention identical and only refines the in-process reentrancy classification from key-present to key-present-AND-current-ALS-context-owns-it. Sync nesting still passes through; concurrent async siblings contend.

preMortem.scenario: ALS context boundary drawn wrong → genuine DONE→audit nesting loses pass-through → self-deadlock
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the existing sync-nesting smoke case + add explicit assertion that DONE→audit still passes through. Run lock-coverage smoke before advancing.

preMortem.scenario: AsyncLocalStorage not propagated across an await in the DONE flow → outer frame loses its own token mid-critical-section
preMortem.trigger: DONE merge intermittently still loses commits in the new self-smoke interleave case
preMortem.mitigation: ALS propagates across await by design; the deterministic interleave smoke (A parks at await, B tries acquire) directly proves propagation. If it fails, the boundary is wrong — fix before REVIEW.

preMortem.scenario: Concurrent sibling now fail-fasts where it used to silently pass → surfaces a NEW user-facing error
preMortem.trigger: parallel stories error on lock contention instead of racing
preMortem.mitigation: This is the CORRECT behavior (contend, not corrupt). The on-disk lock options already define wait/fail-fast; ensure the sibling uses the wait path where DONE expects to retry, not a hard throw. Document in CHANGELOG.
